tasks.title: Keep understated chunk hints out of the exponential dispatcher path
tasks.prompt: WorkDispatcher.make_chunks can choose its exponential optimal partitioner from a caller-provided chunk hint even when the real weight list is much larger. An understated hint such as 1 can therefore send a large workload into branch-and-bound instead of the bounded fastest heuristic. Repair the selection boundary so actual work size controls the algorithm choice while preserving validation and the small-workload optimal behavior.

tasks.title: Bound a wedged UI-robot scenario and reap its process tree
tasks.prompt: The ui-robot matrix can hang forever when one scenario wedges. Add a per-scenario wall-clock watchdog with a safe 900-second default. A timed-out scenario must fail with useful diagnostics, terminate and reap its whole child process group, and leave the other matrix semantics intact. Expose the bound through the existing command-line/configuration surface without turning it into an opt-in safety check.

tasks.title: Accept owner-bound Windows OWNER RIGHTS without weakening DACL checks
tasks.prompt: The capacity-model Windows DACL validator rejects writable OWNER RIGHTS entries (SID S-1-3-4) even after it has independently verified the object's owner SID. Treat OWNER RIGHTS as representing that already-verified owner, but only inside that owner-bound check: an owner mismatch or an unrelated writable trustee must still fail closed. Preserve the existing POSIX behavior.
